title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context

summary: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning.
takeaways: Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost.
Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context.
We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning.
